name: @pipeworx/mcp-setlist-fm

tools.name: artist
tools.description: Fetch a setlist.fm artist record by band name or MusicBrainz ID. Pass `artist_name` ("Radiohead") and the name is resolved to the MBID for you, preferring an exact match so a tribute act does not answer for the band; pass `mbid` directly when you already have one. Returns artist name, MBID, Ticketmaster ID, sort name, and disambiguation info.

artist_name.description: Band or performer name, e.g. "Radiohead". Either this or mbid is required.

mbid.description: MusicBrainz ID, e.g. "a74b1b7f-71a5-4011-9441-d0b5e4122711". Either this or artist_name is required.

tools.name: artist_search
tools.description: Search setlist.fm for artists by name, MusicBrainz ID, or Ticketmaster ID. Returns a paginated list of matching artist records with name, MBID, and sort name.

tools.name: artist_setlists
tools.description: A band's concert history, newest first — use this for "what did Radiohead play at their most recent show". Pass `artist_name` and the band is resolved to its MusicBrainz ID for you, preferring an exact name match so a tribute act does not answer for the band; pass `mbid` directly when you have one. Returns setlists with date, venue, city, and full track lists.

artist_name.description: Band or performer name, e.g. "Radiohead". Either this or mbid is required.

mbid.description: MusicBrainz ID. Either this or artist_name is required.

p.description: Page number, 1-based. Page 1 is the most recent concerts.

tools.name: venue
tools.description: Fetch a setlist.fm venue record by venue `id`. Returns venue name, city, country, coordinates, and URL.

tools.name: venue_search
tools.description: Search setlist.fm for venues by name, city, country, or state. Returns a paginated list of matching venues with name, city, and country.

name.description: Venue name, e.g. "Fillmore". At least one criterion is required.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — "US", not "United States". Call `countries` for the full list.

tools.name: venue_setlists
tools.description: Fetch paginated setlists performed at a specific venue by venue `id`. Returns setlists with date, artist, and track lists.

tools.name: setlist
tools.description: Fetch a single setlist by its setlist.fm `setlist_id`. Returns artist, event date, venue, city, and the full ordered track list with song names.

tools.name: setlist_search
tools.description: Search setlist.fm setlists by artist name/MBID, date, year, city, country, state, tour name, or venue. Returns paginated matching setlists with artist, venue, date, and tracks.

date.description: Exact concert date in dd-MM-yyyy — "06-06-1983", NOT ISO 8601. setlist.fm rejects "1983-06-06" outright.

tools.name: user
tools.description: Fetch a setlist.fm user profile by `user_id`. Returns username, fullname, about text, website, and statistics on attended concerts.

tools.name: user_attended
tools.description: Fetch paginated list of concerts a setlist.fm user has marked as attended, by `user_id`. Returns setlists with date, artist, venue, and track list.

tools.name: cities
tools.description: Search setlist.fm for cities by name or country. Returns city name, state, country, and geolocation coordinates. Useful for resolving city identifiers before searching setlists or venues.

name.description: City name, e.g. "Berlin". At least one of name/country is required.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — "DE", not "Germany". Call `countries` for the full list.

tools.name: countries
tools.description: Return the full list of countries recognized by setlist.fm (ISO country codes and names). Use to look up valid country codes before filtering setlist or venue searches.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-setlist-fm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the setlist-fm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
